title: Deduplicate TrackCreationService/TrackEditService's verbatim study-day persistence loop
rule: Fowler duplication + DB-3 (batch()/insertAll over awaited per-row loops)
why: _saveStudyDaysLocal (track_creation_service.dart:348-368) and _saveStudyDays (track_edit_service.dart:95-115) are byte-for-byte identical except a parameter name — the exact 'delete then loop-await-upsert' method copy-pasted into two sibling services. A future fix (validation, batching, a new column) applied to one copy silently leaves the other stale. Both loops (plus the unbounded _saveScopes loop) await each row individually instead of using Drift's batch()/insertAll, even though they already run inside an open transaction() so correctness is not at risk — only round-trip count.
recommendation: Extract one shared DAO-level batched helper (e.g. StudyDayConfigDao.replaceAll using batch()) and call it from both services; do the same for _saveScopes.
acceptance_criteria: One shared helper implements the delete+insert study-day/scope replacement using batch()/insertAll
TrackCreationService and TrackEditService both call it; no duplicate method body remains
